rules.hegemonic: One authoritative deterministic selection procedure; not consensus or competing agent votes.
rules.diodic: Evidence and allowed state changes flow in one causal direction; historical records append-only and cannot be rewritten.
rules.no_choice: Return top evidence-ranked permissible action using fixed lexicographic order of loss, risk, evidence strength, sampling cost and stable action ID; abstain/observe may rank first when commitment is unsupported.
rules.freeze: At each turn predeclare tests, run holdout only afterward, report all outcomes and counterexamples; success is verified evidence, not favorable metrics.
rules.percent_tracking: Only count a milestone after source, freeze, results, index entry and refetch are verified; no partial success as completion.
rules.boundary: If investigation shifts toward witness consensus, independent witness roots, voting, Byzantine fault tolerance or federated authority, close current phase immediately with freeze and open a separately named next phase. Mentioning those terms as boundary conditions alone is not a trigger.

milestones.target: Positive, zero, and negative ground truth
Causal evidence only; prevent future leakage
Total ordering, deterministic tie-break; abstain is action
Stop or continue according to evidence and cost
Freeze, compare to SG049, failure register, next boundary

closure.early_stop: Boundary-triggered immediate close; denominator changes to actually executed verified turns, with planned 12-turn schedule clearly distinguished from early closure.
